queries.query: LLM OR "large language model" "network configuration" misconfiguration hallucination "network operations"
queries.rationale: Locate empirical reports and analyses of LLM-caused misconfigurations, hallucinated commands, or incorrect network-change proposals to characterise the observable phenomenon.
Survey work that maps operator intent to device/configuration artifacts to understand task formulations and common evaluation tasks used in NetOps generation.
Find architectures that combine generation with verification and iterative repair loops (generate→validate→repair), relevant mitigations against incorrect outputs.

queries.query: network configuration verification formal methods "Header Space Analysis" "NetKAT" "Batfish" reachability invariants
queries.rationale: Collect deterministic verification tools and formalisms used in NetOps validation to identify candidate validators and ground-truth oracles.

queries.query: LLM tool use "tool-augmented" "API calls" "agentic" network devices orchestration
queries.rationale: Identify work on tool-augmented LLMs and agentic orchestration frameworks used to interact with network devices, CLIs, or simulators.
Locate existing benchmark suites and task collections for NetOps/AIOps to assess coverage, validity, and gaps versus operational needs.
source_preferences: project websites and dataset repositories (Zenodo, GitHub)

queries.query: evaluation methodology network experiments emulation "Mininet" "ns-3" "network sandbox" "simulation" "testbed"
queries.rationale: Survey experimental infrastructures and evaluation methods used to validate configuration correctness and network behaviour under generated changes.

queries.query: constrained generation controllable generation "constrained decoding" "safety layers" "policy enforcement" LLM
queries.rationale: Find methods for restricting LLM outputs (decoding constraints, templates, policy grammars) as preventive mitigations for unsafe NetOps outputs.

queries.query: runtime validators policy compliance "pre-deployment checks" "invariant checking" network "policy compliance"
queries.rationale: Identify runtime and pre-deployment validators for policy/invariant checking that can serve as oracles or filters for generated configurations.

queries.query: failure modes LLMs code generation "hallucination" "incorrect commands" "prompt-sensitivity"
queries.rationale: Aggregate literature on LLM failure modes in code/command generation to map mechanisms that produce actionable NetOps errors.
Search adversarial and robustness studies (prompt injection, poisoning) relevant to integrity of NetOps workflows driven by LLMs/agents.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop NetOps "operator-in-the-loop" human oversight intervention "AIOps human"
queries.rationale: Survey hybrid workflows and operator oversight patterns to understand practical mitigations and evaluation protocols that include human checks.
Collect candidate quantitative metrics and evaluation criteria used to judge correctness, safety, and operational impact of configuration changes.
Map broader AIOps/autonomous-network-management literature to extract methods, evaluation paradigms, and limitations adjacent to LLM-for-NetOps work.

queries.query: ethics accountability audit trails change management network automation "explainability" "audit"
queries.rationale: Find literature on governance, auditability, and legal/compliance considerations relevant to agentic NetOps and mitigation requirements.

inclusion_criteria: Primary research articles (peer-reviewed conferences/journals) and arXiv preprints with reproducible methods or code
Tool and dataset repositories (GitHub, Zenodo) with versioned artifacts or DOIs
Benchmarks and dataset descriptions with accessible data or task definitions
System and security conference papers describing empirical results (USENIX, SIGCOMM, NSDI, CCS)
Standards, RFCs, and vendor API documentation when cited for operational semantics
Works dated approximately 2015–2026 to cover modern LLMs and recent NetOps methods, with older seminal works included where foundational
exclusion_criteria: Unverifiable blog posts, opinion pieces, or press releases without reproducible artifacts or citations
Social-media threads (Twitter/X, Reddit) as primary evidence
Proprietary internal reports inaccessible for verification
Non-English sources lacking translation (unless critical) — prefer verifiable English-language sources
Papers that only benchmark generic language knowledge without operational NetOps tasks or failure analysis
date_rationale: Cover literature from ~2015 through 2026 to include pre-LLM foundational NetOps verification work and the rapid evolution of LLM-based methods (GPT-era literature from 2020–2026). Include older seminal verification works as exceptions when they form methodological foundations.
